---
title: "About"
---

**Experiment Library** is a companion website for the class 
**General and Cognitive Psychology** taught
at [Charles University, Faculty of Arts](https://kps.ff.cuni.cz/cs/). 
The experiments are simplified versions of popular cognitive experiments.

The experiments or the website collects no data. 
All experiments display selected results in the end. 
If you want to use these results, ask your participants to submit them via other channels.

The experiments are written using [jsPsych](https://www.jspsych.org/latest/) framework.
Their [source code is publicly available](https://github.com/visionlabels/library) and 
you are free to study the code or use the experiments for your research or teaching.
